title: Live-app end-to-end regression re-run
scope: Re-run the TAX-055 browser regression against the live taxpayer portal and the Frappe-hosted auditor app with seeded demo data, instead of the fixture API and session mocks

acceptance.text: The TAX-055 suite (or a live profile of it) runs against the Frappe-hosted apps with real logins and the TAX-094 seed, covering both personas, three widths and accessibility states
All five scenario routes pass live, including an officer evidence request reaching the taxpayer portal; failures are recorded with fixes or owners; fixture-only paths are clearly separated
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

Exercise native login boundaries, correct case/collection/document destinations, denied direct URLs, session expiry and service unavailability; verify native operations do not bypass approvals and evidence responses reach the same live case.

verification: All five scenario routes pass live, including an officer evidence request reaching the taxpayer portal; failures are recorded with fixes or owners; fixture-only paths are clearly separated

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05: TAX-055 was delivered against fixtures before the live apps existed; this is the live re-run TAX-058 needs.

notes: TAX-105 scope clarification: Connected regression includes the real configured native screens and protected document access, not just mock portal APIs.
